info.title: Socratic API
info.description: API for the Socratic platform — handles users, classes, topics, chat sessions, achievements, friends, OAuth accounts, and Google Calendar integration.

post.summary: Exchange Google Auth Code for Tokens
post.description: Exchanges a Google OAuth authorization code for access and refresh tokens. Upserts the user and account records in the database and registers the user session. Returns the userId and tokens.

code.description: The one-time Google OAuth authorization code from the frontend OAuth flow

200.description: Tokens created and user registered successfully

post.description: Creates an event on the authenticated user's Google Calendar using their stored OAuth tokens. **userId is required** — pass it in the request body or via the `x-user-id` header. Returns 401 if userId is missing or not found.

parameters.name: x-user-id
parameters.description: The user's ID (alternative to passing userId in the body)

userId.description: The authenticated user's ID (can also be passed via x-user-id header)

createMeet.description: Set to true to auto-generate a Google Meet link

200.description: Event created successfully on the user's Google Calendar

401.description: userId is missing or no matching user/Google account found

get.description: Returns the next 10 upcoming events created by Socratic on the authenticated user's Google Calendar. **Requires userId** via `x-user-id` header or `userId` query param.

200.description: A list of upcoming calendar events

401.description: userId is missing or not found

get.description: Returns Socratic-created events on the authenticated user's Google Calendar within an optional time range. **Requires userId** via `x-user-id` header or `userId` query param.

401.description: userId is missing or not found

get.description: Verifies that the provided userId exists in the database and registers the session in memory. Pass userId via `x-user-id` header or `userId` query param.

401.description: userId missing or user not found

post.summary: Upload Document to S3 and Pinecone
post.description: Upload PDF(s) to S3, chunk them using LangChain, and index into the shared Pinecone class namespace.
Generates a dynamic 4-option multiple-choice quiz using Gemini AI over the class Pinecone Vector Knowledge Base.

get.description: Returns all quizzes for a user grouped by topic, with quiz count and average score.

200.description: Array of quizzes grouped by topic

get.description: Returns all classes a user is enrolled in via the user_classes table, joined with full class details (name, subject, syllabus_url, streak, etc.).

200.description: Array of class objects for the user

post.description: Increments the retakes_taken stat counter for the given user. Call after a user starts a retake quiz.

Send a message to the Socratic AI Tutor. Pass an existing `sessionId` to continue a previous conversation — if omitted, a new session is created. The response always returns a `sessionId` and an `isNewSession` flag so the frontend knows whether to add a new entry to the sidebar.

sessionId.description: Optional. Pass an existing sessionId to continue a previous chat. Omit to create a new session.
The chat session ID (new or existing)

isNewSession.description: True if a new session was created. Use this to decide whether to add a sidebar entry.

score.description: 0-5 quality score of the user's question

get.description: Returns all classes in the database.

post.description: Creates a new class. If the class_code already exists, updates the existing record (upsert).

name.example: Data Structures and Introduction to Algorithmic Analysis

delete.description: Deletes all classes, topics, chat sessions, chat history, tasks, and syllabus info from the database. ⚠️ This is a destructive operation.
Deletes a specific class and **all associated data** in this order: tasks → chat history → chat sessions → topics → syllabus info → class. Safe to call even when the class has existing data.

200.description: Class and all associated data deleted

post.description: Extracts structured syllabus data from a PDF or plain text using Gemini AI. Accepts optional user_id and class_code — when class_code is provided it overrides the AI-extracted courseCode for consistency.

syllabusPdf.description: The syllabus PDF file (alternative to pdfText)

user_id.description: ID of the user uploading the syllabus

class_code.description: Class code to override the AI-extracted courseCode

get.summary: Get Syllabus URL for a Class
Get Extracted Tasks for a Class

get.description: Returns class info, all extracted tasks (deadlines), and topics for a given class in a single request.
Returns professor details, TA details, office hours, and grading policy extracted from the syllabus.
Returns a single user with friend_count and achievement_count included
Returns daily or monthly XP. Use ?group_by=month for monthly totals.
Returns quiz count, average score, and color grouped by class name
Returns a list of friends with the classes they share with the logged in user

200.description: Array of friends with shared classes
Array of class engagement data with colors
A list of achievements with unlock status
A list of quizzes with color

get.summary: Get Course Materials for a Class
get.description: Returns all uploaded course materials for a specific class

post.description: Saves a course material record to the database

get.summary: Retrieve all chat sessions from PostgreSQL
Retrieve all messages for a specific chat ID

post.summary: Add a message to a chat session

get.description: Returns the full list of 20 possible achievements

post.description: Records or increments question count for a user in a specific class.

put.description: Updates an existing quiz record with a new score and per-question user answers and correctness. Intended for use after a retake or quiz submission. Also re-runs achievement unlock checks.

questions.description: Questions with updated user_answer and is_correct. Must include each question's id.

get.description: Returns recent achievements earned by all of the user's friends

post.description: Accepts the request, sets status to accepted, and auto-creates the friendship in both directions
Declines and deletes the friend request
